label: Dry cooking batch weight vs OOSW
why: Abalone cooked for dry cooking cannot exceed the OOSW weight recorded for the job on REC 7.1.5 - a higher total means batches from different jobs got mixed. Only Cooking pot cards count; Blanching cards are ignored, so a pot that is blanched then cooked is counted once.
message: Cooking pot weight exceeding OOSW - possible batch mix

label: Dry blanching batch weight vs OOSW
why: Blanching is the first stage, so it obeys the same OOSW cap as Cooking: blanched kg for the job cannot exceed the OOSW weight on REC 7.1.5 - a higher total means batches from different jobs got mixed. Only Blanching pot cards count.
message: Blanching pot weight exceeding OOSW - possible batch mix

label: Dry cooking weight vs blanched weight
why: You cannot cook more than you have blanched: the job's total Cooking kg must be equal to or lower than its total Blanching kg, compared as whole-job totals (not pot by pot). Cooking cards flagged legacyNoBlanching (migrated entries that had no blanching values) are left out.
message: Cooking weight exceeds blanched weight - cooked more than was blanched
